spans.s: मुमुक्षा f. 1. Desire of liberation; 2. desire of final emancipation.
मुमुक्षु (I) a. 1. Desirous of liberating; 2. about to shoot, R.ix.58; 3. striving after final emancipation.
मुमुक्षु (II) m. A sage striving after final emancipation, Bg.iv.15, K.S.ii.51.
मुमूर्षा f. Desire of death, Bt.v.57.
मुमूर्षु a. Being on the point of death.
